Cloud Monitoring: Feature (November 12, 2026)
changes.detail: Creating SQL-based alerting policies to monitor your Observability Analytics query results in Cloud Monitoring is generally available (GA) . You can create SQL-based alerting policies by using the Google Cloud console or the Cloud Monitoring API. For more information, see Cloud Logging: Monitor your SQL query results with an alerting policy and Cloud Trace: Monitor your SQL query results with an alerting policy .
